children: Mubadala Investment Company has agreed to make a significant minority investment in China-based Luckin Coffee Inc. alongside Centurium Capital, the coffee chain's controlling shareholder, in a transaction valued at approximately $1 billion.
The Abu Dhabi sovereign investor, with a $385 billion portfolio, said the investment comes amid continued growth in China's coffee market, driven by rising consumption of freshly brewed coffee.
Mubadala has been expanding its exposure to Asia and China's consumer sector through its private equity activities.
Founded in 2017, Luckin Coffee operates more than 36,000 stores globally, with customer numbers approaching 500 million.
The transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Abu Dhabi's Mubadala invests in China’s Luckin Coffee
